newsitem.title: USA: MOODY'S AFFIRMS LINCOLN NATIONAL CORP.
newsitem.headline: MOODY'S AFFIRMS LINCOLN NATIONAL CORP.

text.p: NEW YORK, July 28 - Moody's Investors Service confirmed the credit ratings of Lincoln National Corporation (senior debt rating at A2) and its life insurance affiliates following the announcement that Lincoln National has signed an agreement to purchase the individual life insurance and annuity business of Cigna Corporation.

According to Moody's, the confirmation of Lincoln National's ratings is based on the strategic benefits provided by the acquisition, including a broader portfolio of products and an expanded distribution network.
The integration of Cigna's life and annuity operations should also generate expense savings through consolidation efforts.

Moody's added that the acquisition would shift the business mix, significantly increasing earnings from individual life, and easing the company's dependence on the highly competitive -- and lower margined -- annuity lines.

The rating agency noted, however, that Lincoln National will face challenges in integrating the sales forces and in substantially growing individual life insurance sales in an increasingly competitive environment.
The transaction, which is structured through an indemnity reinsurance agreement, is valued at approximately $1.4 billion.
Lincoln National plans to fund this acquisition with proceeds from the sales of its American States property and casualty insurance company.
Lincoln National has a leading market position in life and health reinsurance, diversified sources of earnings, and a good-quality securities portfolio.
These strengths are tempered by Lincoln National's concentration in asset-accumulation products, by its sluggish individual life sales, and by its financial leverage, according to the rating agency.
Lincoln National Corporation -- senior debt rating at A2; provisional preferred stock rating at (P)"a2"; and the rating of the company for commercial paper at Prime-1.
Lincoln National Capital I -- preferred stock rating at "a2."
Lincoln National Capital II -- preferred stock rating at "a2."
Lincoln National Capital III -- provisional preferred stock rating at (P)"a2."
Lincoln National (UK) PLC -- the rating of the company for commercial paper at Prime-1.
Lincoln National Life Insurance Company -- insurance financial strength rating at Aa3.
Lincoln Life & Annuity Company of New York -- insurance financial strength rating at A1.

Lincoln National Corporation, headquartered in Fort Wayne, Indiana, reported consolidated assets of approximately $72 billion and shareholders equity of approximately $4.3 billion as of March 31, 1997. Monday, 28 July 1997 17:19:35 ENDS nN28269674
